name: loops
description: Persistent loop and workflow runner for deterministic commands and headless AI coding agents. CLI + MCP + HTTP API (loops-serve) + generated SDK. The only technical switch is the server data backend: sqlite (zero-config on-box default) or postgresql, selected by HASNA_LOOPS_DATABASE_URL. Clients resolve the hosted /v1 connection through the shared @hasna/contracts credential resolver (macOS Keychain, ~/.hasna/loops/config/credentials, HASNA_LOOPS_API_KEY/URL, fleet gateway default) or select the local SQLite file explicitly with HASNA_LOOPS_CONNECTION=file; an unconfigured client fails closed. Local state lives at the effective Loops data home (~/.hasna/loops by default, resolved via @hasna/paths; the XDG data home is adopted only once the store is migrated there or HASNA_DATA_HOME is set).

readinessGates.summary: Protected /v1 routes fail closed without valid tenant-bound API-key authorization.
Public readiness reports stable storage, auth, and migration codes without credential details.
Bundle routes fail closed without the loops:bundle scope, and no agent prompt bytes reach a lower-scoped caller.

bundles.note: Immutable loop@version bundles. Version objects are never overwritten and no presigned URL is ever handed to a client: every byte is served through the API under API-key auth, because a bundle can carry an agent prompt. With no bucket configured the artifacts fall back to a local directory under the Loops data home, for installs with no object store.
